data.title: 能天使 · 滑板出发前的检查
data.location: 龙门街头广场边的长椅
data.description: 【能天使 · 滑板出发前的检查】龙门广场边，能天使穿着红白拼色卫衣和黑色工装裤，耳机挂在颈间，坐在长椅上检查滑板。她一手稳住竖在身旁的板面，另一手用小工具拧紧轮轴，抬头朝你笑了一下——「出发前再检查一遍，可不能滑到一半掉链子！」
data.action: 坐在长椅上，一手稳住滑板，另一手用工具拧紧轮轴
data.promptProse: On a bench beside a Lungmen plaza, Exusiai checks her skateboard in a red-and-white hoodie and black cargo pants, holding the deck upright with one hand while tightening a wheel nut with a skate tool. Clear afternoon light catches the metal axle and the headphones around her neck, with paving stones and low shopfronts receding behind the bench.
data.camera: medium shot, bench and upright skateboard with wheel adjustment visible
data.lighting: 街头广场清透的午后日光
